svg.text: 50000 points from 5 threads, three ingestion protocols, then exact and approximate checks

g.text: what is deterministic, and what is not
what is deterministic, and what is not
The time series arm runs three times, once per ingestion path, against the same single server.
Each thread owns one sensor and a disjoint timestamp range, so the threads never write the same point.
Four hand-written points are added only once the bulk load is done, so their values are deterministic.
ingestVerificationSeries(): sensor VERIFY at ts 0/1000/2000/3000 - expectedTotal = 50000 + 4
The total is exact, but a tag-filtered aggregate only sees the asynchronously sealed subset.
temperature = 15.0 + (i % 20) cycles 15..34, so the extremes settle even though the aggregated count does not
Total count, aggregate extremes over a sealed sensor, and the latest timestamp read from the mutable buffer.
